content.text:
**Analyzing Column Constraints**

Okay, I've got a much clearer picture now. I've mapped the locations of the 5s in each column, seeing patterns in their lengths: column 1 has a single one; column 3 has two, column 5, has three, and column 7 has four. Then I was able to correlate constraints to object sizes, the smallest column gets the red and largest gets blue.

content.text:
**Analyzing Grid Elements**

I've homed in on how to identify objects within the grid. My focus is on extracting specific elements: univalued objects, that are not diagonal, and have no background. It seems clear to me that I must identify the background color first, as the connected components of non-background colors will represent these objects. I'm thinking of a 4-connected scheme to determine this. I am now working on understanding x1.
